README: NAMES FROM MEMORY. NOT CHECKED. Check this list against your own mission deck: your deck wins.
This file holds names only, with a few words of my own saying what kind of thing each one rewards.
It holds no card text and must never hold any. The card in your hand says what actually scores.
To edit: change, add or delete lines in the list below. Keep the commas and quotes as they are.
name   = what the picker shows, at most 24 letters.
cap    = the most points that one secondary may hold for one player, or null for no limit.
Every cap here is null because I could not check the numbers. Put your deck's in if you want them enforced.
scores = a short label in plain words, shown under the name. Yours to reword.
If this file is broken or missing the game still runs: the picker then only offers Type a name.

secondaries.name: Behind Enemy Lines
secondaries.scores: for units in the enemy zone

secondaries.name: Establish Locus
secondaries.scores: for an action near the middle

secondaries.name: Containment
secondaries.scores: for units near the table edges
